Meet Arguseye. Eyes for coding agents.
Real props from your own call sites.
Your theme, your layouts, your global CSS.
The agent gets back a cropped screenshot, the accessibility tree, what changed since its last render, and errors with file paths.
And in VS Code, the preview lives beside your code and updates as you type.
It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, any MCP client.
Arguseye. Open source. One command to install.
